comparator_plan_basis.name: Single cardinality-aware residual-completion density
comparator_plan_basis.motivation: The assessment parity witness differs in the full distribution of total positive residual count. A structured single can exploit that dependence without four component scorers. MaskGAE degree supervision and CAM degree/conservation constraints establish practical graph count ancestry.
comparator_plan_basis.suggested_density: For K=sum_r Z_r, P(Z|h)=pi_K(h)*exp(sum_r t_r Z_r)/e_K(exp(t_1),...,exp(t_R)), where e_K is the elementary symmetric polynomial. pi_K predicts the residual positive count from the same masked usable context; t_r comes from one NCNC completion scorer.
comparator_plan_basis.training_contract: Use exactly the same residual slots, TRAIN observation labels, masking law and label-only teacher. Prebind the new objective/capacity/stochastic recipe independently of pilot outcomes. Full teacher labels cannot become context.
comparator_plan_basis.prediction_contract: A separately prepared competent control should retain the structured density through a fixed paid nonlinear-decoder expectation or sampling scheme, rather than claiming its distribution was evaluated after an unreported mean-weight collapse. For example, four full joint draws can use one shared NCNC decoder and mean raw logits. Exact native clamp, main-loss routing, capacity and work need new source review/qualification.
comparator_plan_basis.cost: Count normalizer/marginals can require O(R²) dynamic programming; decoder draws and all context/lookup work are charged. This is a concrete later control proposal, not a qualified low-cost drop-in or an authorized additional fit.
comparator_plan_basis.scope: Complements the existing competent covariance-aware and full-mode/grouped-single references. It does not alter the frozen representative J/F screen.

analytical_count_control_limit: Parity differs in count distribution. The six-slot laws share full count law and first/second moments but differ at third order. Neither proves graph occurrence, useful learned modes, calibration, native decoder expressivity or superiority over a rich-context/full-mode single.
